caption: The drawing depicts a single, round-bodied bottle with a narrow neck, centered within a rectangular border on a beige or light tan background. The bottle is decorated with vertical bands of twisted patterns in alternating colors including red, green, blue, and white. Some bands have a diagonal, ribbon-like spiral design, while others feature crisscrossing or wavy white lines. The colored patterns are evenly spaced around the surface of the bottle, creating a symmetrical composition. The artist's signature, "John Dana," appears in small text at the lower left corner inside the border.
title: Bottle
